title: Sound in the card: a levelled catalogue, beds under the voice, a Sound control
acceptance: The remaining sound catalogue is levelled to a stated loudness band, measured through the real engine.
The card's Chamber plays beds and tones, ducked under the voice.
A Sound on/off control in the card's Settings.
The premium-educational guide teaches one quiet bed.
The voice trace notes the bed.

evidence.note: The eleven Feelings sounds are parked (#558, #562); this task levels what remains.
Revised 2026-10-09: Claude first, the critical path to the Composer release, and this task's place on it.
Measured through the real engine (layer 0.85, master 0.7, 25 s from t=3 s): all sixteen offered sounds between -29.2 and -28.8 dBFS RMS with their trims; before trimming they spanned -53.2 to -11.5.
Every offered sound has a trim, no parked sound has one, and every manifest entry was measured with the shipped trim and is inside the band.

Trims on soundscapes and tones without changing the configured volume; ducking from the target level during a fade-in and for a bed started under the voice; onSoundStart and sounding; init completes with one warning where indexedDB.open throws SecurityError.
[RISE audio] line per bed and tone, __riseLive.audio(); ducked on speech.start, released on speech.end, voice.failed, voice.taken, voice.held; not ducked when paced; engine released at the end.
Sound row only with an engine; a switch, on by default, off and on through the Chamber and saved as cardSound; a saved off silences the next reading.

Local Chromium, one worker, whole file: 46 passed. New: in the opaque-origin self-contained card, starlight starts within 5 s of Play, Pause then Play keeps it, Sound off stops it, on restores it. Fails without the IndexedDB guard. Fake host, paced voice.
SND-001 pull request; not merged at the time of this record.

Field defect (bed logged as started in the Claude card, heard by nobody): __riseLive.audio().levelDbfs measures the RMS after the engine's last gate. On main the starlight bed measured -Infinity dBFS for the whole reading (sessionGain left at 0 by startSession, never faded in because the Chamber does not play a hosted reading). With the fix: -28.6 dBFS within 5 s of Play, -Infinity within 2 s of Pause, -28.6 again after Play. Local Chromium, one worker: live-mcp + live specs 64 passed; gate 57 passed, 3 skipped.

The host brings the engine's session up as the shown reading plays (1.2 s, then 0.6 s), down as it pauses (0.4 s), stops it when the reading completes, follows only the reading shown, and lets go at the end; the ?measure=1 level tap.
A -29 dBFS bed under the voice floor 0.18 sits at about -44 dBFS (14.9 dB down).

activity.summary: Proposed in the 2026-10-09 reconciliation of records and roadmap.
Built on branch snd-001-card-sound and opened as PR #585: levelled catalogue, beds under the voice in the card, a Sound control, the guide's one quiet bed, and the audio trace.

Field defect fixed on branch card-bed-audible: the card's bed was started but silent (session reveal never opened); the host now opens it on Play as the Reader does, and the browser test measures the level.
Voice-ducking floor raised from 0.18 to 0.35 so a levelled bed stays heard under speech (about -38 dBFS).

Card beds on iPhone (branch ios-audio-unlock): the Play tap resumes the engine's context and, on WebKit, asks navigator.audioSession for playback and starts a silent looping <audio> so the ring/silent switch no longer mutes Web Audio (Ambient category, MediaSessionManagerCocoa.mm); beds lifted +6 dB where hostContext.platform is mobile (e2e median -22.6 vs -28.5 dBFS on web); About adds level and audio session lines. Owner's phone check pending.

summary: Built on branch snd-001-card-sound (PR #585): the sixteen offered sounds levelled to -29 dBFS RMS +-2 dB through the real engine, beds and tones play in the card ducked under the browser voice, a Sound switch in Settings, Premium Educational teaches one quiet bed, and the trace notes each bed. Not yet witnessed in a real host.
